name: The Americana at Brand
description: The Americana at Brand in Glendale, California, is a one-of-a-kind destination that offers a remarkable blend of shopping, restaurants, activities, movies, and entertainment. Located just a short drive away from Downtown Los Angeles and Hollywood, The Americana at Brand enjoys a unique and advantageous location. This premier open-air lifestyle center features upscale retail, diverse dining options, AMC Theatres, family amenities, and year-round entertainment programming including seasonal events and live performances.
demographics: Located near Downtown Los Angeles and Hollywood, serving both locals and tourists in the Glendale area with proximity to major entertainment destinations
summary: A premier open-air lifestyle destination in Glendale offering upscale shopping, diverse dining, entertainment, and year-round events near Downtown Los Angeles and Hollywood.
